description: This PHP source file defines a class for upgrading the database schema of Revive Adserver, specifically handling sequence renaming and default value updates for PostgreSQL databases during an upgrade to version 2.5.67 RC8.

classes.name: OA_UpgradePostscript_2_5_67_RC8
classes.description: A class responsible for executing database upgrade steps related to sequence renaming and default value adjustments for PostgreSQL during a specific software upgrade.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process, renaming sequences and updating default values for autoincrement fields in PostgreSQL.

methods.name: getLinkedSequence
methods.description: Retrieves the linked sequence name for a given table and field by querying PostgreSQL system catalogs.

methods.name: logOnly
methods.description: Logs informational messages during the upgrade process.

methods.name: logError
methods.description: Logs error messages during the upgrade process.
